moments.text: Infrared sensor view looking down: crosshair over a flat grey background that slowly gains a faint mottled texture.
The view zooms out in a flicker: the old picture shows as a rectangle in the centre while the wider view fills in around it.
Mottled ground with dark patches and bright cloud at left. A tiny dark dot appears just above and left of the crosshair.
The view drifts through grey and bright cloud for about two minutes; the tiny dark dot keeps the same spot above and left of the crosshair.
Textured ground shows through and slides past quickly; the dark dot is still in place.
After a quick zoom flicker, cloud clears to a sharp close view of tree cover and a forked dirt track at upper right.
The view widens in steps with flickers: bright cloud over dark ground, then hazy ground with faint straight lines.
Wide view over flat land dotted with many small bright clouds and thin straight tracks.
The view tilts toward a hazy band across the top of the frame, with scattered cloud below, to the end.

notes: No clear object beyond a tiny dark dot fixed at one screen position (32-155 s); could be a sensor artefact.
